parties: Time Technoplast Limited (holding company) acquires TPL Plastech Limited (subsidiary)
headline: Time Technoplast grants in-principle approval for merger of subsidiary TPL Plastech into holding company
sum: Time Technoplast Limited has received in-principle board approval for the merger of its wholly-owned subsidiary TPL Plastech Limited into itself, pending further regulatory and shareholder approvals under the Companies Act and stock exchange norms.
implication: Subsidiary merger under the Companies Act 2013 s.230-232 framework involving a 100% subsidiary and holding company triggers mandatory NCLT approval and shareholder sanction; the 'in-principle' stage indicates pre-filing phase before formal NCLT petition, typical for India-domiciled reorganizations.
detail: Time Technoplast Limited's board has granted in-principle approval for the amalgamation (merger) of its subsidiary company TPL Plastech Limited into itself as the transferee company. This is a corporate restructuring typically aimed at simplification or optimization of subsidiary structure. The approval is expressly subject to further approvals, including those from the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), shareholders, stock exchanges, and other relevant regulatory authorities. As a subsidiary-into-holding merger, the transaction falls under the mandatory amalgamation framework of the Companies Act 2013 and will require NCLT sanction under s.230 et seq.
